findings.detail: Mavenir Systems, Inc. 2L Term Loan source row has interest rate 12.000% PIK, but the extracted private-credit row has no interest_rate or basis_spread.
GCOM source row has interest rate 17.000% PIK, but the extracted private-credit row has no interest_rate or basis_spread.

rationale: X02 flags two private-credit rows with blank interest_rate and basis_spread. The raw SOI source has explicit PIK interest rates for the corresponding debt instruments: Mavenir Systems, Inc. 2L Term Loan shows 12.000% PIK, and GCOM shows 17.000% PIK. Because source supplies rate data that the extracted rows missed, this is a real extraction gap.
